title: Portable Floor Controller
description: This mod adds a controller that put blocks under where you standing. Supported language: English Japanese
body:
This mod adds a controller that add blocks under where you are.
Q and A:

Q.What Does this mod can do?
A.You can move and level the ground confortably.　

Q.Can I remix / use in my mod?
A.Yes. If you write the credit and the difference, you can use it for free.
